verdicts.quote: “API Read and write records over REST and GraphQL, get webhooks when records change, and connect apps with OAuth.” ([github.com](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/blob/main/packages/twenty-docs/developers/introduction.mdx))

verdicts.quote: “There is no static API reference… Each workspace has its own schema…”; “Core API — CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects… Metadata API — … create/modify/delete objects, fields, and relations.” ([github.com](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/blob/main/packages/twenty-docs/developers/extend/api.mdx))
